LESSON: FINANCIAL SERVICES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Entrepreneurship
Topic 5.1: Financial Services
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Financial Services, part of Entrepreneurship in Grade 9 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: What services are offered by different financial institutions in Kenya?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. use print or digital media to search for information on financial institutions available in Kenya,

2. discuss and present the types of financial institutions in Kenya (banks, insurance, SACCOs, micro finance),

3. use print or digital media to search for information on services offered by financial institutions in Kenya,

4. use a case study to discuss services offered by financial institutions in Kenya,

5. engage in a discussion with a resource person on the utilisation of financial services for entrepreneurial development.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. use print or digital media to search for information on financial institutions available in Kenya,
2. discuss and present the types of financial institutions in Kenya (banks, insurance, SACCOs, micro finance),
3. use print or digital media to search for information on services offered by financial institutions in Kenya,
4. use a case study to discuss services offered by financial institutions in Kenya,
5. engage in a discussion with a resource person on the utilisation of financial services for entrepreneurial development.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Financial Services together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: learner acquires skills of organising self-learning when searching for information on services offered by

financial institutions in Kenya.

26

• Self-Efficacy: learner develops effective communication skills when discussing and presenting the types of financial

institutions in Kenya.

• Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving: learner develops interpretation and inference skills when identifying financial

services.

Values:
• Responsibility: learner cares for own property and those of others when handling digital devices when searching for

information on financial services.

• Unity: learner displays team spirit and collaborates with others when discussing and presenting on the types of financial

institutions in Kenya.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Financial Literacy: learner’s financial knowledge is enhanced when discussing and presenting on the types of financial

institutions in Kenya.

Link to other Subjects:

Agriculture: learner enhances knowledge on investment when searching for information on services offered by financial

institutions in Kenya.
